title: Request an Internal Review of a decision about a grant application – Privacy collection notice
summary: This notice explains why and how Service NSW collects your personal information when you request an internal review of a grant decision.

more_info.text: you can access and seek correction of the information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made.
Read the Service NSW privacy statement for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2-24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

internal_links.text: Request an Internal Review of a decision about a grant application

faqs.q: What information is collected when I request an internal review?
faqs.a: Service NSW collects information such as your first and last name, postal address, contact phone number, email address, the name of the applicant, your relationship to the applicant, application reference number, and business name.

faqs.q: How will my personal information be used?
faqs.a: The information will be used to verify your identity and locate your customer record, conduct an internal review of the administrative decision, contact you or an authorized third party about the review, and maintain and use information for internal administrative purposes.

faqs.q: Is it mandatory to provide this information?
faqs.a: The page content does not specify whether you are required by law to provide this information.
